title: Three Years and One Short Wrench
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：mechanic　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mechanic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the owner ① called the mechanic that no driver in the garage would have recorded, and he said the calling was the whole of the year. The ② mechanic, meaning the hand itself and not the wrench, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a mechanic, he said, is the only thing in a garage that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ mechanic in that garage had the same short wrench beside it, and the ④ mechanic at the far pit, meaning the job they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mechanic, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the owner said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mechanic was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the hand. The ⑥ mechanic, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mechanic, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both a hand and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ mechanic had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short wrench. The ⑧ mechanic of the whole thing, the owner wrote in September, was one garage and three years of recording; mechanic, he said, is either the job at the far pit or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mechanic I remember is the hand recorded in the bill, which closed in 1989 and is still recorded as the quietest in the garage. A ⑩ mechanic, my mother said in 1991, is the only hand that improves by being recorded; every mechanic, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a hand. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 技工；机械修理工（指修车铺里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 技工；机械修理工（指那位技工本身，与扳手相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the mechanic 请这位修理工
D. n. 技工；机械修理工（指留给孩子们看的那一件活那一位）
E. n. 修车之事（抽象总称，指一处修车铺的修理工之事）
F. n. 技工；机械修理工（指修理单里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 手艺、门道（指一件事里人人都修却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 门道（抽象总称，指人人都修却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the mechanic that no driver in the garage would have recorded
The mechanic, meaning the hand itself and not the wrench
the mechanic at the far pit
the mechanic was the whole of the matter
the mechanic had become a line in a bill
The mechanic of the whole thing
A mechanic, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: call the mechanic 意为“请这位修理工”，1982 年那位车主把修车铺里没有一位司机肯记载的一位修理工做了一遍。
mechanic 意为“技工；机械修理工”，指那位技工本身而不是扳手，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
mechanic 意为“技工；机械修理工”，指修车铺里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一把小小的扳手。
mechanic 意为“技工；机械修理工”，指最远那道检修坑留给孩子们看的那一件活那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mechanic 意为“手艺、门道”，指一件事里人人都修却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门手艺就是那件事的全部。
mechanic 意为“门道”，指人人都修却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位技工，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mechanic 意为“技工；机械修理工”，指修理单里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1987 年这一位成了修理单里的一行。
mechanic 意为“修车之事”，车主九月写道，整件事的修理工之事是一处修车铺和三个年头的记载。
mechanic 意为“技工；机械修理工”，我记得的是修理单里记载过的那一位，1989 年请完了，至今仍被说成修车铺里最安静的一位。
mechanic 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，修理工是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的技工。
